title: Site spec
description: The structured description of a site to be built. THE SPEC, NOT A PROSE PROMPT, IS THE SOURCE OF TRUTH: the build reads this, and anything not in it was not asked for. Generalized from the CRM website generator's emitted spec (crm-generator/src/assets/engine.js) — its CRM-only blocks (`crm`, `lead_capture`) survive here as optional vertical extensions rather than as core fields.

spec_version.description: Bumped when a field changes meaning, so an old spec is never silently misread.

source.description: Which intake produced this spec. The build path differs: `url` and `design-reference` go through capture, `brief` and `vertical` do not.

vertical.description: A vertical template id when one was chosen (Phase 6), else null.

business.description: Who the site is for. Every field here is a FACT — if the person did not supply it, it is null and listed in `missing`, never guessed.

pages.description: The sitemap. Order is the nav order. A page with no content to put in it does not belong here.

purpose.description: One line: what this page is for. The composition guide reads it to pick a page shape.

shape.description: A page shape from docs/site-creator/composition.md. null = infer from `purpose`.

sections.description: Optional explicit section list, each an archetype + variant from the recipe catalogue. null = let the page shape decide.

variant.description: A variant named in that archetype's recipe file; null = the style's preferred one.

content.description: Slot values for the recipe. A slot absent here is OMITTED, never filled with something plausible.

brand.description: The design direction. `style` names a file in docs/site-creator/styles/; the colours override that style's palette where the business owns one.

style_notes.description: The describe-your-own escape hatch, so the curated set is never a cage.

logo.description: 'supplied' = the owner provides a file (sideload it into the target site's Media Library — a hardcoded URL or a foreign attachment id renders nothing). 'text' = a text logo from the business name.

content.description: Real copy the person supplied, keyed by page slug. The build uses this verbatim where given.

proof.description: Testimonials, logos, metrics, awards — ONLY as supplied. If this is null or empty, the built pages have no proof band. An invented testimonial is not a placeholder, it is a fabricated claim about a real business.

seo.description: Configured against the real business details — never invented locations, hours or service areas.

compliance.description: Cookie notice, privacy policy, consent wording — jurisdiction-dependent and never assumed.

build.description: Where and how it is built.

target.description: The WordPress install: a localhost slug, or a host the person named.

publish.description: DEFAULT DRAFT. Pages are not published until the person asks — see build-rules.md.

theme.description: Child theme slug; null = generate one.

lead_capture.description: OPTIONAL vertical extension (the CRM generator's own block, kept compatible). Forms, notification address, placements.

crm.description: OPTIONAL vertical extension. Pipeline stages, lists, lifecycle emails.

missing.description: THE MOST IMPORTANT FIELD. Every fact the intake could not establish, by id. The build reads it as 'do not invent these': a page whose proof is listed here ships without a proof band, and the person is told what to supply. Carried over from the CRM generator, where it does the same job.
